question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

The room beneath the **__collapsed__** building was empty.
solution: The correct answer is** "mended."** ***__Key Points__** __ • **"Collapsed"** means to fall down or break into pieces suddenly. (अचानक ढह जाना या टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो जाना) • Example:* A lot of buildings **collapsed**__ in the earthquake.* • Therefore, the word "mended" is the most appropriate antonym of the given word. • "Mended" means to repair something that is damaged or broken. (क्षतिग्रस्‍त वस्‍तु की मरम्‍मत करना) __ • Example: She **mended**__ the photocopier.* • Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Finished: **to complete something or reach the end of something. (किसी काम को पूरा या समाप्‍त करना) • **Cracked: **to break or to make something break so that a line appears on the surface, but without breaking into pieces. (चटकना, दरकना; दरार पड़ना) • **Choked: **to be or to make somebody unable to breathe because something is stopping air getting into the lungs. (दम घुटना या घोटना) 39:T11af, The correct answer is "does."
